literal: He who loved / not granting / things that say / it seems / having paled / tears / flowing / eyes
translation: My eyes, turning pale and brimming with tears, seem to proclaim the unkindness of my lover.
modern: பசலை நிறம் கொண்டு கண்ணீர் வடிக்கின்ற என் கண்கள், என் காதலர் எனக்கு அன்பு காட்டாததை உலகத்தார்க்குச் சொல்வன போல இருக்கின்றன.
explanation: The speaker observes the physical toll that separation has taken on her eyes. They have lost their natural beauty, turning pale (பசந்து), and are constantly shedding tears (பனி வாரும்). She feels that these visible signs of sorrow act as a public declaration. They seem to announce to everyone the unkindness (நல்காமை) of her lover (நயந்தவர்), who has left her to suffer without his comforting presence.
